title: EE60072: Real Time Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to Real-time systems: Typical examples of RTS. Characteristic
features
of
RT
applications.
Structural, Functional
and
Performance
requirement of
Reactive
RTS. Distinctive features from Non-RT and Off-line
system. Modelling RTS: Representation of time,
Concurrency
and
Distributedness
in
discrete
event
systems,
Hierarchical
representation of complex DES. Input, Output and Communication. Examples of
modelling practical systems as RT DES. Modelling programs as RTS.
Analysing RTS: Analysing logical properties of DES such as Reachability,
Deadlock etc. Analysing timing related properties. Specification and
Verification of RT DES properties. Temporal logic, Model checking. Example of
checking safety and timing properties of industrial systems.
Requirements and features of real-time Computing Environments: Real-time
Operating Systems, Interupts, clock, Device support, Multi
tasking, Static
and Dynamic
Scheduling,
Resource Allocation, Real-time Programming
language with examples drawn from existing languages. Real-time communication
systems.
